pages.title: Arcane Ruins
pages.text: You can find the Arcane Ruins in the End Highlands, only inhabited with a few Pillagers guarding it's loot.$(br2)It's here that you'll find some key ingredients for your progression - $(l:sin_alignments/ashes_of_sin)Ashes of sin$() and Inscription Smithing Templates.
These items can be used in a Smithing Table to make an aligned Herbal Sigil.
Sift through Suspicious End Stone using a $(l:utilities/syrum_brush)Syrum Brush$() to find some loot!
